snippet.title: Sunset Artisan Chocolate - Cozy Chocolate Shop - Gameplay Teaser (Steam)
snippet.description:
Run a cozy seaside chocolate boutique!🍫 Weigh, melt, and craft handmade treats for your colorful customers, experiment with new recipes, meet locals, grow your chocolate brand, and settle into life in Sunset Town.

Wishlist now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4702900/Sunset_Artisan_Chocolate/
